meta.name: exploratory-data-analysis
meta.description: Perform bounded, local exploratory analysis of explicitly supported scientific files. Use for redacted CSV/TSV/JSON profiles; optional NumPy, HDF5, FASTA/FASTQ, and basic image metadata inspection; missingness/leakage audits; outlier and transformation sensitivity; and rigorous EDA report scaffolds. Other domain formats are reference-only and unknown formats fail closed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对科学数据进行探索性分析并生成报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速分析科学数据集并发现异常
copy.tagline_en: Perform exploratory analysis on scientific data and generate reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly analyze scientific datasets and detect anomalies

howto.what: 当你给 Claude 一个科学数据文件，它会自动识别文件类型，分析文件结构、数据质量和统计特征，然后生成一份 markdown 格式的探索性分析报告，包含格式说明、质量评估和后续分析建议。仅对支持的科学数据格式生效，未知格式会失败。
howto.when: 当用户提供科学数据文件路径、要求探索/分析/总结该文件，或询问数据质量与分析方法时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析一下 reads.fastq，生成一份探索性报告。
say.note: 会识别文件类型并输出 markdown 报告。

say.text: 探索这个 experiment_results.csv 的结构和数据质量。
say.note: 会给出统计摘要和缺失值检查。

say.text: 这个 cells.nd2 显微图像文件里有什么信息？
say.note: 会提取维度、通道和元数据。

howto.what_en: When given a scientific data file, Claude auto-detects type, analyzes structure, quality, and statistics, then generates a markdown EDA report with format info, quality checks, and recommendations. Only supported formats work; unknown fail.
howto.when_en: When the user provides a scientific data file path, asks to explore/analyze/summarize it, or asks about data quality and appropriate analysis methods.

say_en.text: Analyze reads.fastq and produce an exploratory report.
say_en.note: It will identify the file type and output a markdown report.

say_en.text: Explore the structure and data quality of experiment_results.csv.
say_en.note: It will provide summary statistics and missingness checks.

say_en.text: What information is in this cells.nd2 microscopy image file?
say_en.note: It will extract dimensions, channels, and metadata.
